snippet.title: Danganronpa Blowback | Prologue (Eng Sub)
snippet.description:
Today I begin my journey through DRBB, I'm going on a blind playthrough, i never watched this game before so I know nothing of these characters besides their names and talents when I began translating these events. So i'm eager to find out about this game and what monolab wanted to re-create for this fangan. Hope you guys enjoy the video and take care out there!

Also be sure to check my Ko-fi page, we have a current goal for streaming videos, if you want to see translation streams, gameplays or reaction video requests, then please donate to the channel for these kinds of videos💛
💖DOWNLOAD LINK : https://zephi.itch.io/danganronpablowback-english
💚Patreon :https://www.patreon.com/Zephirum
🤎The Ko-fi channel! :https://ko-fi.com/zephirum 
Given the current creator is gone since a few years and this project is abandoned the link i'll share for this will be the wiki page : https://fanganronpa.fandom.com/wiki/Danganronpa_Blowback
One last thing, the current prologue is still being fixed, since i've noticed a few errors and typos but i'll make sure to share it once everything is taken care of and move on to chapter 1.
